The quantized representation is the sequence of indices $\{i_1, i_2, \dots, i_K\}$ where $i_k$ is the index of $c_k$ in $C_k$ [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states that the Gaussian attribute vector is partitioned into K clusters (sub-vectors) $z_k$ using K-Means. It further specifies that each cluster $z_k$ is quantized using its own codebook $C_k$. In vector quantization, the representation of a quantized vector is defined by the index of the closest codeword in the codebook. Therefore, the sequence of indices corresponding to the quantized clusters $c_k$ in their respective codebooks $C_k$ constitutes the quantized representation. The claim accurately describes this process found in the text.
